source.replayedFrom: frozen SK1 VALIDATION class records (privileged local data, hash-bound to the tracked population summary) through the frozen kernel, frozen C10 policy and frozen evaluator

disclosure: Opaque aliases only. No seed, world hash, block coordinate, utility vector or member identity. Per-action flags are categorical outcomes of the frozen evaluator on the frozen member worlds. "NONE" means no catastrophe was observed in the sampled member worlds; it does not mean the action is universally safe.

definitions.introduction: frozen potentialIntroduction of the decision set against the comparator set in at least one member world
definitions.safeAlternative: an action that introduces against neither comparator in any member world of the class (Gate 1 definition F)
definitions.forcedChoice: the kernel's top-ranked decision set on every class, including classes where it abstained; a diagnostic reading, not the policy as specified
definitions.rankingStage: for a failing class, the stage of the frozen ranking contract at which the unsafe set overtook the best-ranked safe alternative (descriptive, rule-based)
definitions.stability: leave-one-bag-out re-run of the frozen ranking contract; POST_HOC_DIAGNOSTIC
